title: Unleashing Divine Destiny in Your Finances Career and Marriage
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he kicks off a powerful week of revival, declaring that no weapon formed against your finances will prosper as you operate in the opposite spirit. Hear Pastor Chris's bold prayer of declaration, filled with Scripture and expectation, as he calls out for the Lord to bless and prosper His people. Get ready to be encouraged, empowered, and released into a week of breakthrough and abundance!
